panels.title: About
panels.description:
### Sandbox resource metrics
Host Sandbox measures the host cgroup (including runtime); Guest Workload measures the workload inside the sandbox. These are sandbox resource totals, **not physical node/cluster capacity**, and must not be added together. CPU rates are cores; throttled time is seconds/second. Limits are sums of exported finite limits, not physical capacity. No sample is not zero. Guest rates exclude observed epoch-change windows; they are not exact rollback accounting. Dropdowns are scoped by cluster → node → sandbox → guest container, and refresh with the selected time range. Node inventory counters are node context, not a sandbox running-state count.
